% The space that \\[len] adds below a table's row, as in the PDF: a
% positive and a negative skip, in ems and in points, before an \hline,
% in the title's \author, and in a longtable. An array in math is left to
% MathJax.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{longtable}
\title{Row skips}
\author{A. Writer \\[0.5em]
    \begin{tabular}{c}Department of Tables\\[3pt]A University\end{tabular}}
\date{}
\begin{document}
\maketitle

\noindent\begin{tabular}{|l|l|}
    \hline
    First & no skip below \\
    Second & 0.5em below \\[0.5em]
    Third & 6pt below \\[6pt]
    Fourth & $-4$pt below \\[-4pt]
    Fifth & 6pt below, then a rule \\[6pt]
    \hline
    Sixth & last \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{longtable}{|l|l|}
    \hline
    First & no skip below \\
    Second & 0.5em below \\[0.5em]
    Third & 6pt below \\[6pt]
    Fourth & $-4$pt below \\[-4pt]
    Fifth & last \\
    \hline
\end{longtable}

An array in math: $\begin{array}{c} a \\[6pt] b \end{array}$.
\end{document}
